title: Java 17 Features
description: Check your understanding of records, sealed classes, text blocks, and modern Java language features.

questions.questionText: What is a primary use of a Java record?
questions.solution: Records provide concise syntax for classes whose main purpose is carrying immutable data.

questions.questionText: Which clause lists the allowed subclasses of a sealed class?
questions.solution: The permits clause explicitly names classes that may extend a sealed class.

questions.questionText: Which delimiter starts and ends a Java text block?
questions.solution: A text block is enclosed by triple double-quote delimiters.

questions.questionText: Pattern matching for instanceof primarily removes which repeated operation?
questions.optionC: Explicit casting after a type check
questions.solution: The matched variable is already typed, avoiding a separate explicit cast.

questions.questionText: Which type may directly implement a sealed interface?
questions.optionA: Only a type named in its permits relationship
questions.solution: A sealed hierarchy restricts direct implementations to its permitted types.
